messages.content: The Columbus hospital finally answered. Thursday walk-through can run as late as 8 p.m., they'll lock the demo gear in the lab overnight, and Saturday teardown is expected around 4:15 but could slip. Can we turn the hold into a real plan now? I want the practical choice, not just whatever is cheapest.

Yes. The cleaner travel pattern is the late-afternoon nonstop: TPA 4:50 p.m. to CMH 7:03 p.m. Thursday, then CMH 1:42 p.m. to TPA 3:55 p.m. Sunday. The cheaper connection saves about $80 but lands close to midnight, so it gives up the walk-through and turns Friday morning into setup recovery. On lodging, the hospital-adjacent hotel wins on location only. Recent reviews are uneven and they still will not confirm a mini-fridge. The suite hotel 15 minutes away confirmed a queen studio with coffee maker, mini-fridge, indoor pool, and fitness room. It does not have a hot tub. My pick is nonstop plus suite hotel.
Does Sunday afternoon still leave enough room if Saturday drifts later?

Yes. Since you are not flying Saturday night, even a 5:30 or 6 p.m. teardown just becomes dinner and a normal checkout Sunday. The 1:42 p.m. return is late enough to avoid a rushed morning but not so late that you get back to Tampa wiped out. The 8 a.m. Sunday option is cheaper, but it gives you no recovery margin.
What am I giving up by not staying next to the hospital?

Mostly five to ten minutes each way. You gain a more predictable room and confirmed morning setup. The adjacent hotel still cannot tell me whether the room has a refrigerator, and the recent comments flag noise and housekeeping inconsistency. For a two-day lab, I would not trade the known room basics for that small commute.
Fair. Do I need the compact car now that they'll store the gear?

Probably not. With the gear locked in the lab, rideshares should cover airport-hospital-hotel and the two teaching mornings for less hassle than a rental plus parking. The only caveat is trunk space for the demo bag on Thursday; I'd request a comfort-size ride from CMH and go straight to the hospital before the hotel.
Okay. Book the nonstop and the suite, cancel the car hold, and take the window seats if they're still there.

Before I ticket it: the flight is Main Cabin, not refundable back to the card, though changes are allowed with any fare difference. The suite hotel is cancellable until Aug 17 at 6 p.m.; after that one night is due. The hotel has the pool and fitness room but no hot tub. Thursday still depends on the nonstop arriving close to schedule. Total right now is $286 round trip and $169 per night before taxes. Want me to proceed?
Proceed. Those caveats are fine.

Booked. Airline confirmation C7M4RA, with 12A on the Thursday nonstop and 14A on the Sunday return, both window seats. Hotel confirmation SU-21874 is for Aug 20-23 in a queen studio at the suite hotel, coffee maker and mini-fridge noted on the reservation. I canceled the compact-car hold.
Send the receipts and put the Thursday stop order in the notes. I don't want to lose time figuring that out after landing.

Receipts are sent. Trip note now says: land CMH, request comfort-size rideshare, go directly to the hospital rehab/lab entrance with the demo bag, complete the room walk-through and lockup, then rideshare to the suite hotel for late check-in. If the landing slips enough to threaten the 8 p.m. cutoff, call the hospital contact from the plane gate before leaving CMH.

messages.content: The airline just emailed: Thursday nonstop moved later. Is this now too tight for the lab, or should I change to the connection?

I rechecked it. The nonstop now lands at 7:36 p.m. Keeping it works only if the order stays CMH to hospital to hotel. The lab contact can wait until 8:45, not beyond that, and a direct rideshare from CMH to the rehab entrance is about 20-25 minutes, so there is still a usable buffer. The connection gets in earlier, but it leaves Tampa before your faculty call is likely to wrap and adds a fare difference. I would keep the nonstop unless you expect to check the demo bag.
I can carry the demo bag. I do not want to bail on the faculty call.

Then keep the nonstop. Do not stop at the hotel first; that would burn the buffer. Request the ride as soon as you are off the plane, text the hospital contact once you are in the car, and aim to be at the rehab entrance around 8:05-8:15.
Can you make sure the hotel will hold the room if I show up close to 10? And reconfirm the room setup while you're at it.
I'll verify late arrival, no cancellation before overnight audit, queen studio, coffee maker, and mini-fridge. I'll also ask whether they need a note that you are coming after a hospital stop.
Yes, add that. I don't care about the lobby pitch; I just need the room there.

Confirmed with the suite hotel. They added late arrival for 9:45-10:15 p.m. and said the guaranteed card holds the room past normal check-in. The reservation still shows queen studio with coffee maker and mini-fridge; indoor pool and fitness room are open, no hot tub. The hospital is fine with rideshare drop-off at the rehab entrance. Revised Thursday plan: keep the retimed nonstop, rideshare straight to the hospital, walk through and lock gear, then check in.

messages.content: Five days out: hospital says use the rehab loading entrance for the demo bag, visitor parking is separate from the main garage, and Saturday teardown now includes returning borrowed mats. Tighten the local plan.

Thursday: rideshare straight from CMH to the rehab loading entrance; ignore garage details unless a driver gets misrouted. Text the contact from the car. Friday leave hotel 7:05 for 7:30 room access. Saturday leave 7:10 and expect teardown to run long because of mats.
And food? I'm too late Thursday to improvise.

Use the room basics: in-room coffee, mini-fridge, packed bars/oatmeal for Friday morning. Skip late grocery delivery. Do a small Friday delivery after class for yogurt, fruit, bottled drinks, and Saturday breakfast.
Good. Add those times and set the Friday delivery.

Done. Trip note has CMH to rehab loading entrance Thursday, hotel departure 7:05 Friday and 7:10 Saturday, plus mats-to-storage on teardown. Friday delivery is scheduled to the hotel for 5:30-6:00 p.m.; no Thursday food hunt.
